sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (multiple SI options available; illustrations show ₹5,00,000; higher SI options referenced e.g. 50 Lacs+)

room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day (or Single Private Room, per Policy Schedule)
room_rent.note: Policy Schedule specifies either 'Single Private Room', 'Single Private Room (upgradable to next level)', or '1% of SI per day'. Optional Cover 16 (Room Rent Modification) can upgrade to Single Private Room or No Limit. Baseline depends on SI/plan chosen; most common base is 1% of SI/day or Single Private Room.

icu.display: 2% of SI/day (or no sub-limit, per Policy Schedule)
icu.note: Policy Schedule specifies either '2% of SI per day' or 'no sub-limit'. Optional Cover 16 removes ICU cap entirely. Baseline is 2% of SI/day unless Policy Schedule states no sub-limit.

copayment.display: None (base); optional co-pay for age 61+ via Optional Cover 18
copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base plan. Optional Cover 18 introduces a co-pay for insured persons aged 61+. Optional Cover 7 (Smart Select) adds 20% co-pay for non-listed hospitals. Benefit 11 (Global Coverage excl. USA) has mandatory 10% co-pay.

sub_limits.display: Named ailment sub-limits if specified in Policy Schedule
sub_limits.note: Sub-limits for cataract, knee replacement, hernia, hysterectomy, BPH, renal stones, cardiovascular, cancer, renal complications, bone fractures apply only if specifically mentioned in Policy Schedule. If not mentioned, no sub-limits apply.

deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Optional Cover 5 (Deductible Option) allows policyholder to opt for an aggregate deductible in exchange for premium discount.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 24 months via Optional Cover 12)
ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional Cover 12 (Reduction in PED Wait Period) reduces it to 24 months at additional premium.

maternity.note: Benefit 15: Maternity Cover is inbuilt but available only under floater cover for insured persons aged 18+. 24-month waiting period from first policy inception. Limit as specified in Policy Schedule. Voluntary MTP in first 12 weeks excluded.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 50% (10%/yr, inbuilt); up to 100% with NCB Super add-on
cumulative_bonus.note: Base No Claims Bonus (Benefit 10): 10% per claim-free year, max 50% of Base SI. Optional Cover 4 (NCB Super) adds 50%/yr up to 100% of SI additionally. Bonus reduced by 10% (or 50% for NCB Super) on claim.

restoration.display: Once/year, 100% of Base SI (same & different illness)
restoration.note: Benefit 7 (Automatic Recharge): reinstates Base SI once per policy year after full exhaustion; available for same or different illness. Optional Cover 3 (Unlimited Automatic Recharge) extends this to unlimited times per year.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (extensive list in Annexure I)

domiciliary.display: Covered (up to limit in Policy Schedule)
domiciliary.note: Benefit 6: Domiciliary Hospitalization covered via reimbursement only, must exceed 3 consecutive days. Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: Benefit 9: AYUSH in-patient treatment at registered AYUSH hospitals covered up to Base SI via cashless or reimbursement.

organ_donor.display: Covered (up to limit in Policy Schedule)
organ_donor.note: Benefit 5: Organ Donor Cover for donor's medical expenses during transplant surgery. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered.

ambulance.display: Covered up to Base SI (reasonable & customary charges)
ambulance.note: Benefit 4: Road ambulance covered up to Base SI as specified in Policy Schedule. Air ambulance available via Optional Cover 14.

modern_treatments.note: Benefit 1(iv): 12 listed advance technology methods covered including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy (haematopoietic), HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.

consumables.note: Annexure II lists extensive non-medical/consumable items excluded. No inbuilt or optional consumables cover identified.

global_cover.display: Inbuilt (excl. USA); Optional for USA inclusion
global_cover.note: Benefit 11: Global Coverage (excl. USA) inbuilt, 45 days/trip, 90 days/year, 10% mandatory co-pay. Benefit 14 (Care Anywhere): major illness treatment abroad up to Base SI. Benefit 17 (Global Plus): inpatient abroad if diagnosed in India. Optional Cover 1 extends to USA. Optional Cover 13 extends duration to 90 days/trip, 180 days/year.

grace_period.display: 30 days (15 days for monthly premium mode)

notable_exclusions: Hazardous/adventure sports (professional), external congenital anomaly, refractive error <7.5D, sterility/infertility/IVF, cosmetic surgery, RMO/surcharges/night charges, non-medical consumables (Annexure II)
optional_riders: NCB Super (50%/yr up to 100%), Unlimited Recharge, Deductible Option, Global Coverage-Total (incl. USA), Travel Plus, Everyday Care (OPD), OPD Care, Personal Accident, Accidental Hosp. SI top-up, Room Rent Modification, Air Ambulance, PED Wait Reduction (24mo), Smart Select (15% discount), Loyalty Bonus (3x SI after 3 claim-free years)
